capabilities: mirror Alissa projects, tasks, context, deliverables and entities into Markdown notes
refresh the mirrored content with one click
configure the Alissa API token and target subfolder
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not cross-device vault syncing; it pulls content from the Alissa app into the vault as notes.
extras: Not yet approved for the Obsidian community plugin list; available via BRAT or manual release download. README describes privacy handling: the token is stored locally and only the configured Alissa API base is contacted.
problem: Content created in the Alissa app exists outside Obsidian and has to be manually copied in to become part of the vault's knowledge graph.

relations.evidence: Mirror your Alissa vault into Obsidian: projects, tasks, context, deliverables and entities as wikilinked markdown

summary: Plugin that mirrors an Alissa vault into Obsidian as wikilinked Markdown notes of projects, tasks, context, deliverables and entities, refreshed with one click.
